answer: Start from light client proof of BSC state. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Cloning 554 keys multiplies the price 554-fold: 57616 POA locked, or 8310 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One karst of signal, one ocean of cost, one zephyr of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
